# Data Governance Journey

> Data Governance Journey provides strategic Data Governance consulting and Data Literacy training led by Sandy Bradbury (CDMP Certified).

## Framework & Methodology
- Based on DAMA DMBOK2 (Data Management Body of Knowledge).
- Focuses on 3 core pillars: Foundations/Policies (The Compass), MVP & Tools (The Engine), and Change Management/Data Culture (The Heart).

## Services
- Data Governance Framework Design & Setup.
- Data Quality Profiling & Business Glossary Creation.
- Data Literacy Workshops & Corporate Change Management.
- Executive Data Balance Diagnostics.

## Key Practitioner
- Sandy Bradbury: Lead Consultant, CDMP Associate & Data Management Fundamentals Certified.
